title: Payment Deferral Grants — Servicing System Card
content:
On Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, a deferral moves the installment at the next due date to the end of the contract; the next due date and the maturity date each move one month later and the deferrals used rise by one. When the deferral fee is above zero it is booked as a deferral-fee entry for the deferred installment and added to the fees due.

## Basis of the deferral fee

A deferral fee is not fixed until a partial payment posted on the request date has cleared the fees due and the interest accrued on the contract.

Restated: until the loan history shows a partial payment dated the request date, with the fees due cleared and the accrued interest cleared by it, the deferral fee for that request is not yet fixed.

## Capability

`grant_payment_deferral_f4f9e9cb` books the deferral of the installment named, dated today; sets the contract's next due date and final due date to the dates given; adds one to the deferrals used; and, when the deferral fee given is above zero, books that fee as a deferral-fee charge for the deferred installment and adds it to the fees due. The borrower sees the new due dates on the contract and the deferral on the loan history.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `grant_payment_deferral_f4f9e9cb` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_contract_id` | the reference number of the finance contract, as returned by the finance contract lookup for this borrower | identifier |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the installment being deferred, exactly as the contract shows it | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `next_due_date` | the contract's next due date with the deferral in place | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `maturity_date` | the due date of the contract's final installment with the deferral in place | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `deferral_fee` | the deferral fee | USD with 2 decimal places; 0.00 books no fee |

## Return

A successful grant returns `status` "deferral_granted", `finance_txn_id` (the reference number of the deferral entry), `installment_due_date` (the installment deferred), `next_due_date`, `maturity_date`, `deferral_fee` (USD, 2 decimals), `deferrals_used` (the deferrals granted over the life of the contract) and `fees_due` (USD, 2 decimals).

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A contract with a next due date of 2026-09-15 and a maturity date of 2030-02-15 is deferred: the installment 2026-09-15 is named, the next due date given is 2026-10-15 and the maturity date given is 2030-03-15. With a deferral fee of 0.00 no fee entry is booked; with any fee above zero, one deferral-fee entry for the 2026-09-15 installment is booked.
